run_image_classification_inference: run image classification inference on a single image using a pretrained ResNet50 model
run_batch_image_classification: run batch image classification on multiple images with visualization saved to a directory
list_classification_models: list all available image classification model names matching an optional wildcard pattern
run_classification_with_custom_classes: run image classification inference with a custom class list for labeled predictions
run_classification_return_datasamples: run image classification inference and return raw DataSample objects instead of processed results
